By default only errors make `tusk doctor` exit 1, so a warning won't fail CI. To make it gate CI, run `tusk doctor --fail-on warning`. This also fails on any other warning, such as `index-not-built`. The docs don't give a full option list or exact exit codes for `tusk doctor`.
